🇲🇽🌎 105 MEXICAN QUEEN ANTS SEIZED IN TOYS BOUND FOR LAOS

Profepa intercepted 105 live queen ants of the Mexican genus Pogonomyrmex — hidden inside plastic toys in Jalisco and falsely declared "collectible figures" — as they were about to ship to Laos. A parcel worker flagged the package; 87 surviving ants were released back into the Cerro Viejo protected reserve. Biopiracy is trafficking too, and this time it was caught at the counter.

🇲🇽🌎 ITALY RETURNS 27 PRE-COLUMBIAN PIECES — 840+ HOME SINCE 2013

Italy just handed 27 pre-Columbian archaeological and paleontological pieces back to Mexico — three Teotihuacan heads (200 BC–650 AD) found in a Milan inheritance, Early Classic Maya terracotta figurines seized in Rome — all pulled from the international art-trafficking trade by the Carabineri. At the Rome embassy, Ambassador Genaro Lozano noted more than 840 pieces have come home since 2013, under Sheinbaum's "Mi Patrimonio No Se Vende" campaign. INAH catalogs them as the inalienable property of the Nation.

🚨🇲🇽 FIRST PAN GOVERNOR IN MEXICAN HISTORY ARRESTED FOR FUEL SMUGGLING

Ernesto Ruffo — the PAN's very first opposition governor, elected in Baja California in 1989 and paraded for decades as the clean face of Mexico's right — was arrested today by the FGR for organized crime and huachicol fiscal. Prosecutors say the 74-year-old was majority shareholder of Ingemar, a firm tied to smuggling more than 15 million liters of US fuel into Mexico. The very racket the 4T is dismantling, built into the origin myth of the "honest" opposition.

🇲🇽⚖️ Mexico still wants answers on how "El Mayo" was taken to the United States. Sheinbaum assigned the federal Attorney General's Office to investigate the circumstances of his detention and transfer. — President Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera, July 16 A capo delivered onto US soil outside any extradition process remains, for Mexico, a violation of its sovereignty to be accounted for.

🇲🇽🌱 From concrete to wetlands: rethinking how a nation heals its water. Mexico's river cleanup replaces "gray infrastructure" with natural solutions — wetlands, revegetation, reforested hillsides. Diagnostics covered 340 km and 322 sampling sites, exposing 3,202 industrial discharges and 479 clandestine dumps. — Alicia Bárcena, Environment Secretary, mañanera, July 16 Reconnecting people with living rivers is one of the program's four stated goals.

🇲🇽🔍 Sheinbaum wants independent international experts back on the Ayotzinapa case. In talks with the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, she proposed an independent expert group to review the methodology and validate new lines of investigation into the 43 disappeared students. — President Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera, July 16 Nearly twelve years on, the state is inviting outside scrutiny — not hiding from it.

🇲🇽🛢️ Gas held at 24 pesos, diesel at 27 — even if global oil markets spike. Sheinbaum said the government will absorb international price shocks to keep fuel affordable for working families. — President Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera, July 16 A sovereign energy policy means prices set in Mexico City, not by speculation on foreign markets.

🔥🇲🇽 89 textile factories caught dumping chemicals into Mexico's rivers. Eight shut down. Environmental inspectors hit polluting industries with fines of up to 56 million pesos and closed eight facilities outright. — Mañanera, July 16 Under the old model, industry poisoned the water and paid nothing. That era is ending.
